name: Suppress Fatigue, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bloodlord 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, inquisitor 3, shaman 3

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as suppress fatigue, except as noted above.
